verdict.rationale: Together AI ships first-party agent skills that teach a user's AI coding agent to write correct Together AI code, plus a docs MCP server, so a user can direct an external agent in natural language to produce code that uses the platform. However, the docs MCP server only provides documentation lookup, and the skills generate code rather than letting natural-language commands operate the platform directly (deploying endpoints, launching fine-tunes, managing resources). missing for 10: a native natural-language interface or operational MCP tools for platform actions, evidence of conversational control of deployments/fine-tuning/batches, hands-on corroboration.
